answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in knoll and cedar lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the mesa graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1320 impostors cost 1666 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear.
